rounds.text: Shri Niwas Leasing & Finance Ltd trades at an extraordinary valuation anomaly, sporting a P/E of 0.01x [E1] alongside a staggering ROCE of 195.0% [E6], which massively dwarfs the sector median ROCE of 6.1% [E54]. Fundamental business performance has exploded across every timeframe, evidenced by compounded sales growth reaching 140% over the trailing twelve months [E10] and compounded profit growth hitting an astonishing 1459% over 3 years [E13]. This fundamental juggernaut is backed by a scanX DCF model pointing to an intrinsic value of Rs 79,462 per share against a market price of ₹ 11.5, delivering a theoretical margin of safety of 100.0% [E26, E27]. Furthermore, insiders are putting their skin in the game, with promoter holdings surging from 1.94% in Sep 2023 to 15.71% as of Jun 2026 [E24], while the stock enjoys strong technical momentum sitting above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E31]. Conceded: operating cash flow turned negative at Rs -5 Cr in Mar 2026 and working capital days expanded dramatically [E20, E42].
